h1: Custom Koozie Beanies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Koozie beanies in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for outdoor events and corporate gifts. Soft, warm, and branded.
introHtml: Koozie is known for durable outdoor gear like coolers and chairs, but their beanies bring the same rugged quality to headwear. Made from soft, warm acrylic, these custom Koozie beanies are built to last through cold weather events, trade shows, and outdoor employee gifts. The classic knit design provides a generous surface for embroidery or screen printing your logo. Choose from a range of colors to match your brand palette, and order in bulk for your next seasonal promotion or company outing.
heroAltText: Custom Koozie beanies with embroidered logo on a dark knit beanie, perfect for cold weather promotions
